description.value: Creston Valley Motel — self-described as the 'Clean to the Corners' motel — sits just east of downtown Creston within walking distance of pubs, coffee shops, and restaurants, making it a convenient overnight stop on BC's southern interior routes. The property offers a range of room types from single-bed units to full kitchen suites, a drive-through parking lot that accommodates trailers and RVs, and free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout. Pet-friendly rooms are available on request, and the about page notes walking distance to Creston's hospital for any emergencies.
